name: legacy-govone-capture
description: Login GOVOne PMDB → crawl menu/pages → extract fields for QLBD migration context

scripts.pipeline:deep: node capture.mjs --deep && node map-to-features.mjs && node analyze-screenshots.mjs && node map-to-step-context.mjs && node map-to-demo-mfe.mjs
scripts.pipeline:full: node capture.mjs --full && node map-to-features.mjs && node analyze-screenshots.mjs && node map-to-step-context.mjs && node map-to-demo-mfe.mjs
scripts.pipeline:rescan: node capture.mjs --rescan --headed --all-menus --retry=2 && node map-to-features.mjs && node map-to-step-context.mjs && node map-to-demo-mfe.mjs
scripts.pipeline:rescan:maintenance: node capture.mjs --rescan --headed --master=maintenance --all-menus --pause-on-fail --retry=2 && node map-to-features.mjs && node map-to-step-context.mjs && node map-to-demo-mfe.mjs
